system.description:
Averaged suit: light helmet, breastplate pectoral, vambraces, leather tunic. For skirmishers, slingers, sappers, archers, artillerymen and some marines. Swords & Glory armour is bought piece by piece. The 1975 armour classes count only leather, chainmail, plate and shields, so this piece does not change armour class on its own; agree the suit's armour class with the referee.

Swords & Glory price range in Káitars; the referee rolls (usually 1d10) for quality and the real price. The encumbrance cost uses the S&G scale (in hand or worn / hung or packed), not 1975 Káitar weights.
